payloadSchema.title: brain.note@1
payloadSchema.description: One markdown note in the brain — the Obsidian-style page the entity preview renders. Wikilinks stay as written; resolved edges are brain.assertion@1.

notes: UI: the entity preview at IntentsPlaceholder.svelte:1294 — front matter (tags, erstellt, quelle), an H1, prose with [[wikilinks]], '## Offen' checkboxes, '## Verknüpft', 'Backlinks · 3'.
Backlinks are never stored on the note. They are a projection over brain.assertion@1 — that is the whole reason assertions are their own type.
body is inline up to the bound; longer notes move the markdown into the blob. Both forms are searched.
The '## Offen' checkboxes in the mock-up render todos.task@1 rows; they are not note content.
